objective: Integrate exactly one Model Designer into MainWindow and connect a successfully saved canonical model definition to the existing TrainingPage model path while preserving all current training, inference, cancellation, preview, export, and close behavior.
acceptance_criteria: MainWindow creates one stable ModelDesigner reference and adds it exactly once as a Model Designer tab without removing, reordering, duplicating, or otherwise breaking the existing Training and Inference pages.

A successful designer save can explicitly select that canonical JSON for training through a small stable GUI interface, updating the existing TrainingPage Model JSON field rather than creating a second training request path.
Cancellation of a file dialog, failed validation, failed load, or failed save does not change the TrainingPage model path and does not start training.
TrainingPage continues to construct requests only through the existing build_training_request path, and the designer does not call TrainingController or QtTrainingWorker directly.
The selected designer output remains an ordinary canonical model-definition path, so browse-selected and externally authored valid Model JSON files remain fully compatible.
Existing TrainingPage enable/disable, asynchronous QThread/worker lifecycle, stop/close coordination, rerun, result display, and artifact behavior remain unchanged.
Existing InferencePage single/folder request mapping, preview, progress, cancellation, export, rerun, and MainWindow close coordination remain unchanged.
The designer adds no asynchronous work; idle and active-training close behavior remains non-blocking with no wait(), busy loop, terminate(), duplicate close request, or duplicate signal connection.

qtbot tests use fake controllers where execution behavior is relevant and verify tab identity, signal/path handoff, error no-op behavior, request mapping, and existing lifecycle contracts programmatically without real inference, CUDA, network, screenshots, or arbitrary sleeps.
No application, training, inference, model_definition public API, artifact schema, dependency, launcher, or Git operation is changed.
claude_prompt: Implement Phase 14 CP2 only in the six allowed files. Integrate exactly one CP1 ModelDesigner as a stable MainWindow tab while preserving the existing Training and Inference tab objects, ordering, lifecycle, and centralized non-blocking close coordination. Add only the minimum explicit saved-model handoff needed so a successful designer save/use action sets TrainingPage's existing Model JSON path. TrainingPage must continue to use _build_request -> build_training_request; do not introduce another controller, worker, request builder, schema, or model-definition API. Failed/cancelled designer operations must be no-ops for the training path. Preserve external Model JSON browse compatibility and every existing training/inference thread, cancellation, preview, export, rerun, result, and close behavior. Use qtbot and fake backends for focused integration assertions; do not run real inference/CUDA/network, rely on sleeps/screenshots, add dependencies/markers, weaken assertions, touch files outside the allowlist, or perform Git operations.
estimated_scope: Medium focused integration across three GUI modules and three existing/focused GUI test modules, approximately 260-480 changed lines.
